questions.question: What is the output of this Pandas program?
questions.code:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.DataFrame({"Name": ["Asha", "Ravi"]})
print(df.shape)
questions.explanation: The DataFrame has 2 rows and 1 column.

questions.question: What is the output of this Pandas program?
questions.code:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.DataFrame({"Name": ["Asha", "Ravi"], "Marks": [88, 42]})
print(df.shape)
questions.explanation: There are 2 rows and 2 columns.

questions.question: What is the output of this Pandas program?

questions.question: What is the output of this Pandas program?
